sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界的一些重量级领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费全站新闻访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After the assassination of its president, Haiti was struck by a major earthquake.
sentences.zh: 在海地总统遭暗杀后，海地又遭受了一场大地震的袭击。

sentences.en: My colleague, Maria Abihabib, was there reporting on the first crisis when the second crisis hit.
sentences.zh: 我的同事玛丽亚·阿比哈比卜当时正在那里报道第一场危机，这时第二场危机发生了。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月18日，星期三。

sentences.en: Maria, where were you when this all started last weekend?
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，上周末这一切刚开始时你在哪里？

sentences.en: So, on Saturday morning, I'm in my hotel room in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, FaceTiming with my husband and our two children,
sentences.zh: 周六早上，我在海地太子港的酒店房间里，正和丈夫及两个孩子进行 FaceTime 视频通话，

sentences.en: because I've been on assignment and out of the house for about a week at this point.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时在执行公务，已经离家大约一个星期了。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I feel the entire room just jolt to the left and then jolt to the right.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我感到整个房间先是向左猛烈一晃，接着又向右猛烈一晃。

sentences.en: And my husband could see the alarm on my face.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫能看到我脸上惊恐的表情。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 他问我，你知道，怎么了？

sentences.en: And I said, I think that there's an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 我说，我想是发生地震了。

sentences.en: He said, you need to get out right now.
sentences.zh: 他说，你得马上出去。

sentences.en: So, with my phone in my hand and my kids still on video call, I ran out to the parking lot of my hotel, and I discovered all the hotel staff and security guards,
sentences.zh: 于是，我手里拿着手机，孩子们还在视频通话中，我跑到了酒店的停车场，发现所有的酒店员工和保安，

sentences.en: the guests that are staying at the hotel in their pajamas, and everybody is looking for some sort of open sky so that they can make sure that, you know,
sentences.zh: 穿着睡衣住在酒店的客人们，大家都在寻找某种开阔的天空，以确保，你知道，

sentences.en: building or trees don't fall down on them.
sentences.zh: 建筑物或树木不会倒塌砸到他们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I immediately recognized that everybody was just thinking, please, God, let this be over.
sentences.zh: 我立刻意识到每个人心里都在想：求求上帝，让这一切过去吧。

sentences.en: Let this just be it.
sentences.zh: 让这就结束吧。

sentences.en: Shortly after, my Haitian colleague, André Altré, called me to see if I was okay.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，我的海地同事安德烈·阿尔特打电话给我，看我是否平安。

sentences.en: And after establishing that I'm fine and he and his family are fine, we then start talking about where is the epicenter.
sentences.zh: 在确认我和他及他的家人都平安无事后，我们开始讨论震中在哪里。

sentences.en: And he eventually tracks it down.
sentences.zh: 他最终追踪到了震中位置。

sentences.en: And reveals that the epicenter is in the southern peninsula, about 85 miles west of Port-au-Prince, the capital.
sentences.zh: 并透露震中位于南部半岛，距离首都太子港以西约85英里。

sentences.en: And at that point, we start trying to figure out a way to get there.
sentences.zh: 在那时，我们开始想办法去那里。

sentences.en: Can we take the roads?
sentences.zh: 我们能走公路吗？

sentences.en: No, because they're controlled by gangs that are kidnapping people for ransom.
sentences.zh: 不能，因为那些路被绑架勒索的黑帮控制了。

sentences.en: Can we take commercial flights?
sentences.zh: 我们能坐商业航班吗？

sentences.en: No, because they've been stopped.
sentences.zh: 不能，因为航班已经停飞了。

sentences.en: And then we kind of figure out that the best way to get there is by hiring a helicopter.
sentences.zh: 然后我们觉得去那里的最好方法是租一架直升机。

sentences.en: And we were able to get there pretty much 24 hours right after the quake struck.
sentences.zh: 地震发生后大约24小时，我们基本上就赶到了那里。

sentences.en: And what do you find when you get to the southern peninsula and get out of this helicopter onto the ground?
sentences.zh: 当你到达南部半岛并从直升机上下来踏上地面时，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: Complete and utter mayhem.
sentences.zh: 完全彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: You get onto the tarmac and literally I walk maybe 50 feet and just immediately there are two people with injuries,
sentences.zh: 你一踏上停机坪，真的，我大概走了50英尺，马上就有两名受伤的人，

sentences.en: both on wheelchairs that are being taken onto the helicopter that I just arrived on so that they can be shuttled to Port-au-Prince for emergency care.
sentences.zh: 都在轮椅上，正被抬上我刚坐的那架直升机，以便被运送到太子港接受紧急救治。

sentences.en: And then as I'm just about to exit the gates of the airport for Lakai, which is, you know, where the earthquake struck next to,
sentences.zh: 就在我快要走出莱凯机场大门时——你知道，这就是地震袭击的那个地方附近——

sentences.en: a pickup truck pulls up and there's a woman in a pink dress lying in the bed of the pickup truck, her left face swollen.
sentences.zh: 一辆皮卡车停了下来，皮卡车斗里躺着一个穿着粉红色裙子的女人，她的左边脸肿着。

sentences.en: And she says that she can't feel her legs.
sentences.zh: 她说她感觉不到自己的双腿了。

sentences.en: And she had come from an area on the outskirts of Lakai.
sentences.zh: 她来自莱凯郊区的一个地区。

sentences.en: Her entire house collapsed on top of her.
sentences.zh: 她的整栋房子都压垮在她身上。

sentences.en: And the local hospital had no ability to x-ray her to see if her back was broken or what was wrong with her.
sentences.zh: 当地医院没有X光设备来检查她的背部是否骨折或她到底哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so where do you go from the airport?
sentences.zh: 那么你从机场去哪儿呢？

sentences.en: So Andre and I started asking everybody, where should we go?
sentences.zh: 安德烈和我开始问每个人，我们该去哪里？

sentences.en: And everybody says, don't go to Lakai.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说，不要去莱凯。

sentences.en: Go to the mountains and the hillsides that overlook Lakai.
sentences.zh: 去俯瞰莱凯的山脉和山坡。

sentences.en: Because those are incredibly poor towns and villages.
sentences.zh: 因为那是极其贫困的城镇和村庄。

sentences.en: And you have houses that are just completely pancaked and are clinging off the sides.
sentences.zh: 那里的房子完全像千层饼一样塌陷了，悬挂在山坡边缘。

sentences.en: And nobody knows the full scale of the disaster there.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道那里灾难的全面规模。

sentences.en: And we immediately start driving to the hills and the mountains that surround Lakai.
sentences.zh: 我们立即驱车前往环绕莱凯的山丘和山脉。

sentences.en: So we drive out and the road is completely cracked.
sentences.zh: 我们开车出来，路面完全裂开了。

sentences.en: I mean, giant crevice through the middle of it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，路中间有一道巨大的裂缝。

sentences.en: Entire boulders are in the middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 巨大的巨石横在路中央。

sentences.en: And then you're just seeing people.
sentences.zh: 然后你看到的全是人。

sentences.en: I mean, we drove 25 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们开了25公里。

sentences.en: Everybody's camping outside of their homes.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在家门外露营。

sentences.en: You know, they brought plastic chairs to sit on the side of the road or their mattresses from their beds if they were able to recover them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们把塑料椅子搬到路边坐着，如果能抢救出来的话，就把床上的床垫也搬出来了。

sentences.en: Or they're just sleeping out on the grass.
sentences.zh: 或者他们直接睡在草地上。

sentences.en: Because either their houses have been completely destroyed or they're so badly cracked that they just look like a layer cake that's been flattened.
sentences.zh: 因为要么他们的房子被彻底摧毁了，要么裂缝太深，看起来就像被压扁的夹层蛋糕。

sentences.en: And, you know, you can't go in when a structure is that unstable because it could collapse with any tiny little vibration.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当建筑结构如此不稳定时你根本不敢进去，因为任何微小的震动都可能导致它坍塌。

sentences.en: So people are petrified and everybody's staying outside.
sentences.zh: 所以人们吓坏了，所有人都待在外面。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, literally at this point, I had seen no building that is spared in some way.
sentences.zh: 因为，说实话，此时此刻我没看到有哪栋建筑在某种程度上幸免于难。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So we keep driving and eventually we get to this town about 25 kilometers or 15 miles outside of Lakai.
sentences.zh: 于是我们继续开车，最终来到了距离莱凯约25公里或15英里的小镇。

sentences.en: And we enter this church complex with various buildings, including a seminary, secondary school, a guest house for visiting priests, you know, residences for the priests.
sentences.zh: 我们进入了这个教堂综合体，里面有各种建筑，包括神学院、中学、供来访神父居住的客房，以及神父们的住所。

sentences.en: And it's all destroyed.
sentences.zh: 一切都毁了。

sentences.en: I mean, just veins, marbly veins, just crevices that have been caused by the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 我是说，到处都是纹路，像大理石纹一样的脉络，全是地震造成的裂缝。

sentences.en: And there's a bulldozer, men with sledgehammers, men with their hands trying to rescue two women from the residence or a guest house, I should say, of this church complex.
sentences.zh: 这里有一台推土机，男人们拿着大锤，男人们正用双手试图从这个教堂综合体的住所——或者说客房——里营救两名女性。

sentences.en: And nobody knows if the women are alive or not.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道这两个女人是死是活。

sentences.en: So Andre and I come across this young man named Melchorod Walter.
sentences.zh: 安德烈和我遇到了一个叫梅尔乔罗德·沃尔特的年轻人。

sentences.en: And he doesn't live in the town, but his sister was there staying at the guest house and working.
sentences.zh: 他不住在这个镇上，但他的姐姐当时住在客房里并且在那里工作。

sentences.en: And as soon as the earthquake happened, he realized that he and his family were OK.
sentences.zh: 地震发生后，他意识到自己和家人平安无事。

sentences.en: They started calling her and there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 他们开始打电话给她，但没有人接。

sentences.en: So he hitched a ride and it was just the saddest thing.
sentences.zh: 于是他搭便车赶了过来，那场面真是让人难过极了。

sentences.en: He said something to me like, I came here hoping to find my sister.
sentences.zh: 他对我说了一些类似这样的话：我来这里是希望能找到我的姐姐。

sentences.en: And then I saw this and he gestures to the scene and he said, and now I have no hope.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到了这个——他指了指眼前的景象——他说，现在我没有任何希望了。

sentences.en: So I'm walking through this compound and I came across Father Cornet Fortuna.
sentences.zh: 当我走过这个大院时，我遇到了科尔内·福图纳神父。

sentences.en: And he told me that he was just about to leave that morning when he felt the shaking and then all of a sudden the entire house collapsed and he was miraculously spared.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，那天早上他正要离开，突然感到一阵摇晃，接着整栋房子轰然倒塌，而他奇迹般地幸存了。

sentences.en: I mean, he he said it was a miracle.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他——他说这简直是个奇迹。

sentences.en: But the problem was, was that the front door was blocked from the outside by cement cylinder blocks and he was unable to open it.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，前门被外面堆积的水泥空心砖堵住了，他根本打不开。

sentences.en: And so he found a corner of the house that hadn't collapsed and he sought refuge there, screaming, screaming, screaming, asking for help.
sentences.zh: 于是他找到了房子里一个没有坍塌的角落，在那里寻求庇护，大声地、大声地、大声地尖叫着求救。

sentences.en: Finally, he heard his name being screamed by friends of his and he screamed back and said, I'm here, I'm here, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 最后，他听到他的朋友们在喊他的名字，他便大喊回应道：我在这里，我在这里，我在这里。

sentences.en: And with their bare hands, they just start brick by brick, trying to find him.
sentences.zh: 他们仅凭双手，一块砖一块砖地开始寻找他。

sentences.en: And he emerges from the rubble unscathed.
sentences.zh: 他毫发无伤地从废墟中钻了出来。

sentences.en: I mean, tiny little wound on his left foot.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的左脚受了一点点轻伤。

sentences.en: So Father Fortuna takes us further in and he shows us the secondary school, which is second floor, just completely collapsed into the firSt.
sentences.zh: 福图纳神父带我们往里走，向我们展示了中学，二楼已经完全塌陷到一楼。

sentences.en: This school was built in the 1940s and it serves about 870 students, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，这所学校建于20世纪40年代，大约有870名学生。

sentences.en: And a third of them are too poor to pay tuition, so they just waive the tuition fee.
sentences.zh: 其中三分之一的学生太穷付不起学费，所以学校直接免除了他们的学费。

sentences.en: And he tells me that these kids, they get a hot lunch every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，这些孩子每天下午都能吃上一顿热乎的午餐。

sentences.en: And for as many of them, that's the only proper meal that they really have in the entire day.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的很多人来说，那是他们一整天里唯一正经的一顿饭。

sentences.en: And, you know, I kind of, I start realizing that really the church is the institution.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我开始意识到，教堂确实是这里的核心机构。

sentences.en: This is where people go and get help.
sentences.zh: 这是人们去寻求帮助的地方。

sentences.en: This is the only institution of support that they know.
sentences.zh: 这是他们所知道的唯一的支援机构。

sentences.en: This is where they can educate their kids.
sentences.zh: 这是他们可以教育孩子的地方。

sentences.en: This is where they can get maybe some medical aid.
sentences.zh: 这是他们或许能获得一些医疗援助的地方。

sentences.en: And this is where they have a community.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们拥有社群的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm asking him what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我正在问他接下来会怎么样。

sentences.en: And the church is really damaged.
sentences.zh: 教堂损毁严重。

sentences.en: I don't see any buildings that can be used.
sentences.zh: 我没看到有任何建筑还能使用。

sentences.en: And he tells me, Haiti is a country where every disaster is possible.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，海地是一个各种灾难都可能发生的国家。

sentences.en: And there's no government.
sentences.zh: 这里没有政府。

sentences.en: And we must do what we can to provide for the population.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽我们所能为民众提供保障。

sentences.en: He says that even if these buildings are not going to be repaired anytime soon, come what may, they are going to restart school in September.
sentences.zh: 他说，即便这些建筑短期内无法修复，无论发生什么，他们也将在9月份重新开学。

sentences.en: Because without them, without the church, there's nothing for these kids.
sentences.zh: 因为没有了它们，没有了教堂，这些孩子就什么都没有了。

sentences.en: And they're going to be loSt.
sentences.zh: 他们将会迷失。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，去看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Maria, of all the damage that you're seeing near the epicenter of this earthquake,
sentences.zh: 所以，玛丽亚，在这场地震震中附近你所看到的种种破坏中，

sentences.en: it feels like the cruelest is these churches because they represent really the social safety network in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 感觉最残酷的就是这些教堂，因为它们确实代表了海地的社会安全网。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is the safety network in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 是的，它就是海地的安全网。

sentences.en: And every single church that we came across, and we saw many, devastated, either totally destroyed or marbled with deep cracks in the wall, totally structurally unsound.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到的每一座教堂——我们看到了很多——都被摧毁了，要么彻底倒塌，要么墙上布满了深深的裂纹，结构完全不安全。

sentences.en: You don't want to spend any time underneath the roofs because really it could just all come crashing down on your head with any vibration.
sentences.zh: 你根本不想在屋顶底下待上一秒钟，因为任何震动都可能导致它全部砸在你的头上。

sentences.en: And a lot of people feel like, you know, the Catholic Church, which has been there throughout, is gone.
sentences.zh: 许多人觉得，你知道，一直陪伴着他们的天主教教会，现在没了。

sentences.en: It's just not there.
sentences.zh: 它就是不在了。

sentences.en: There's no government.
sentences.zh: 这里没有政府。

sentences.en: And they've got nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没有。

sentences.en: You know, just a month ago or so, the president of this country was assassinated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就在一个月左右前，这个国家的总统刚刚被暗杀。

sentences.en: You know, in this area of the Southern Peninsula that I did my reporting in, a giant hurricane swept through in 2016, and they haven't even recovered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我进行报道的南部半岛这个地区，2016年曾遭受过一场特大飓风的袭击，他们甚至还没恢复过来。

sentences.en: And this hurricane brought a bunch of salt water from the ocean into the agricultural fields that everybody in this area relies upon.
sentences.zh: 这场飓风将海里的大量咸水带到了该地区所有人赖以生存的农田中。

sentences.en: And the soil is just embedded with salt, and crop after crop has just failed.
sentences.zh: 土壤里满是盐分，庄稼一季又一季地绝收。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And people are poorer at this moment than they've ever been because they can't sell their crops.
sentences.zh: 由于无法出售农作物，人们此刻比以往任何时候都更加贫困。

sentences.en: And then to have this earthquake happen, it just seems so unfair.
sentences.zh: 然后在这种情况下又发生了一场地震，这显得太不公平了。

sentences.en: And of course, there was another devastating earthquake in 2010.
sentences.zh: 当然，2010年还发生过另一场毁灭性的大地震。

sentences.en: Yes, and that was in Port-au-Prince.
sentences.zh: 是的，那次是在太子港。

sentences.en: And the devastation there is still on people's minds.
sentences.zh: 那里的满目疮痍仍然留在人们的记忆中。

sentences.en: I mean, I didn't experience it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我没有经历过。

sentences.en: I wasn't here.
sentences.zh: 我当时不在那儿。

sentences.en: But my team, two Haitian journalists, and a Scottish security guard who happened to be here at the time,
sentences.zh: 但我的团队——两名海地记者，以及当时恰巧在那里的一个苏格兰保安，

sentences.en: they all told me they had a really hard time sleeping in the days after Saturday's earthquake.
sentences.zh: 他们都告诉我，在周六地震发生后的几天里，他们很难入睡。

sentences.en: Because all they kept thinking about was the images of bodies stacked on the street in Port-au-Prince after the 2010 earthquake.
sentences.zh: 因为他们脑子里不断浮现出2010年地震后太子港街头堆满尸体的画面。

sentences.en: People fighting in the street with knives over a bottle of water.
sentences.zh: 人们在街头为了争夺一瓶水而持刀互殴。

sentences.en: The desperation, the inability to even walk into a hospital because the hospitals were so crowded.
sentences.zh: 那种绝望，甚至无法走进医院因为医院人满为患。

sentences.en: The morgues were just completely filled.
sentences.zh: 停尸房完全挤满了人。

sentences.en: And that trauma still lives with them today.
sentences.zh: 这种创伤直到今天依然伴随着他们。

sentences.en: How do the people that you talk to make sense of the tragedy upon tragedy upon tragedy nature of the last 15, 20 years in Haiti?
sentences.zh: 你采访过的人，是如何理解海地过去15到20年间这种接连遭遇重重悲剧的现状的？

sentences.en: How do they talk about it?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么谈论这个话题的？

sentences.en: I mean, people just, it's this really resigned way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们只是，带着一种非常无奈的态度。

sentences.en: You know, before my colleagues and I set off to Lakai, people were just looking at the beautiful vista from our hotel and shaking their head and just saying,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我和同事出发前往莱凯之前，大家只是看着酒店外面美丽的风景，然后摇着头说，

sentences.en: my God, like, this country just doesn't deserve this.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这个国家怎么会承受这样的命运。

sentences.en: Go on a helicopter ride from Port-au-Prince to Lakai, as we did.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所做的那样，从太子港坐直升机飞往莱凯。

sentences.en: And it's just beautiful Caribbean sea and mountains and some of the most beautiful scenery I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 展现在眼前的是美丽加勒比海、群山，还有我见过的最壮丽的风景之一。

sentences.en: And everybody's just like, how is this country in such a state?
sentences.zh: 每个人都在想，这个国家怎么会变成这副德行？

sentences.en: I mean, this is the type of place that should be prospering.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个本该繁荣昌盛的地方。

sentences.en: It's got everything.
sentences.zh: 这里应有尽有。

sentences.en: It's beautiful.
sentences.zh: 风景优美。

sentences.en: It's got an amazing culture.
sentences.zh: 有着令人惊叹的文化。

sentences.en: And yet, it's just one of the most devastating places I've ever been to.
sentences.zh: 然而，它却是我去过的最满目疮痍的地方之一。

sentences.en: And people are just, they just feel like they have no answers anymore.
sentences.zh: 人们只是觉得，他们再也找不到任何答案了。

sentences.en: And they're really fed up of all of the tragedy that just seems to, it's just relentless.
sentences.zh: 他们真的受够了所有这些仿佛永无止境的悲剧。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Maria, you started to hint at this when you said that churches play such a central role in the lives of the Haitian people and that the government is not seen as the answer.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，你刚才提到教堂在海地人民的生活中占据着核心地位，而政府并不被视为解决问题的办法，你当时就是在暗示这一点。

sentences.en: And I imagine the government is even less equipped to handle the situation given last month's assassination.
sentences.zh: 我想，鉴于上个月发生的暗杀事件，政府在应对这种局面时更是捉襟见肘。

sentences.en: But is the government in any kind of position to offer any help to the kind of people you're meeting?
sentences.zh: 但是，政府现在有能力向你见到的这些人提供任何帮助吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 完全没有。

sentences.en: I mean, one analyst I speak to actually says it's not a failed state, it's an aid state.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我采访过的一位分析人士实际上指出，这不是一个失败的国家，而是一个依赖援助的国家。

sentences.en: This country has relied on so much aid.
sentences.zh: 这个国家长期以来过度依赖援助。

sentences.en: And what that has done has basically hauled out these institutions and not built up capacity for the government to do things like launch a major relief effort and distribute that relief.
sentences.zh: 而这带来的结果基本上是掏空了这些机构，导致政府根本没有能力开展诸如发起大规模救援行动并分发救灾物资之类的工作。

sentences.en: And my Haitian colleagues, I was asking them, you know, what's the situation?
sentences.zh: 我曾问过海地的同事，你知道的，现在情况怎么样？

sentences.en: What NGOs are here?
sentences.zh: 有哪些非政府组织在这里？

sentences.en: Who's doing what?
sentences.zh: 谁在做什么？

sentences.en: We need to tally it for our reporting.
sentences.zh: 我们需要统计这些来做报道。

sentences.en: And they were just completely shocked.
sentences.zh: 他们当时感到十分震惊。

sentences.en: They just said there's just really not a lot of activity.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，这里其实并没有多少救援活动。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of aid coming in.
sentences.zh: 没有多少援助物资进来。

sentences.en: You know, at this point, NGOs just are kind of tapped out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，到了这个时候，非政府组织也已经精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: And there's just not enough money in the world right now for Haiti.
sentences.zh: 眼下世界上根本没有足够的资金来救助海地。

sentences.en: There's just not, we're not seeing, you know, the immense amount of aid that other disasters in Haiti have attracted, including the 2010 Port-au-Prince earthquake.
sentences.zh: 根本没有，我们没有看到海地以往遭遇其他灾难时吸引来的海量援助，包括2010年的太子港大地震。

sentences.en: And we started asking people in Lakai, in a town in the village that we went to outside of Lakai, who have you seen?
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始询问莱凯的人们，以及我们在莱凯郊外走访的一个村庄里的居民，你们都见过谁？

sentences.en: Who's been here?
sentences.zh: 谁来过这里？

sentences.en: Government help, NGOs, who's been here?
sentences.zh: 政府的救援、非政府组织，谁来过？

sentences.en: And they all said, you're the only outsiders that we've seen here.
sentences.zh: 他们都说，你们是我们在这里看到的仅有的外来人员。

sentences.en: I've seen no one else.
sentences.zh: 我没见过其他人。

sentences.en: So these people are very much on their own.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人基本上只能靠自己。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what they said to me.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说的话正是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, one example, when we went back into Lakai, we went up to the general hospital because we'd been in touch with a doctor there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，举个例子，当我们回到莱凯时，我们去了总医院，因为我们之前和那里的一位医生取得过联系。

sentences.en: And that doctor said that for the general hospital of Lakai, it was just him and one other surgeon for the entire hospital.
sentences.zh: 那位医生说，对于莱凯总医院来说，整个医院就只有他和另一位外科医生。

sentences.en: And the hospital was so badly damaged.
sentences.zh: 而且医院损毁极其严重。

sentences.en: And they were using the parking lot as a triage center and an outpatient center.
sentences.zh: 他们把停车场当成了分诊中心和门诊部。

sentences.en: So they had this shipping container and they were doing surgeries there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有一个集装箱，在那里做手术。

sentences.en: But by nature of how small and tight that space was in that container, they couldn't do complex surgeries.
sentences.zh: 但由于那个集装箱的空间实在太小、太狭窄，他们无法进行复杂的手术。

sentences.en: And they were turning dozens of patients away and saying, we just can't handle you.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不把几十名患者拒之门外，告诉他们，我们实在无能为力。

sentences.en: Your injuries are too serious.
sentences.zh: 你的伤势太严重了。

sentences.en: And they were asking them to go to another hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们要求患者去另一家医院。

sentences.en: But that hospital was two hours away.
sentences.zh: 但那家医院在两小时车程之外。

sentences.en: And in the parking lot, you had just so many hospital beds where people who had just gone through surgery had been recovering.
sentences.zh: 在停车场里，摆着许多病床，刚做完手术的人们就在那里休养。

sentences.en: And we met this one woman who happened to be traveling through Lakai and decided her and her husband decided, you know what, let's just stay the night.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了一个女人，她碰巧路过莱凯，她和丈夫决定，算了，不如在这住一晚吧。

sentences.en: It's kind of late.
sentences.zh: 时间不早了。

sentences.en: So they decided to spend the night in Lakai at a hotel.
sentences.zh: 于是他们决定在莱凯的一家酒店过夜。

sentences.en: And then the next morning, as they're getting ready to venture out again and continue their journey, the shaking started in their hotel.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当他们正准备再次出发继续行程时，酒店里开始剧烈摇晃。

sentences.en: And as they were running out on the staircase, the entire staircase just overturned.
sentences.zh: 正当他们顺着楼梯往外跑时，整段楼梯突然坍塌了。

sentences.en: And she had rubble that collapsed on her, but it was her left foot that was completely shattered by this rubble.
sentences.zh: 坍塌的废墟砸中了她，她的左脚被废墟彻底砸碎了。

sentences.en: And the rest of her body was relatively fine.
sentences.zh: 她的身体其他部位相对完好。

sentences.en: And her husband, you know, in a panic, started waving down passerby's, you know, help me, help me, who can take my wife to the hospital?
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫惊慌失措地开始向路人挥手求救，救救我，救救我，谁能带我妻子去医院？

sentences.en: And this one woman stopped and took husband and wife to the hospital where they then amputated her left foot.
sentences.zh: 这时有个女人停下车，把这对夫妇送到了医院，在那里他们截去了她的左脚。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And she was under the shade of a tree in this hospital bed in the parking lot with chickens running up and down the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 她躺在停车场病床上的一棵树荫下，周围还有鸡在停车场里跑来跑去。

sentences.en: And I noticed that she had this bar of soap that she had balanced on the branch of the tree that was giving her shade.
sentences.zh: 我注意到她把一块香皂平衡卡在为她遮阴的树枝上。

sentences.en: And I asked her, so, you know, what's the situation here?
sentences.zh: 我问她，那么，这里的状况怎么样？

sentences.en: And she said, we lost everything in that hotel, our wallets, our cell phones, everything.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们在那家酒店失去了一切，钱包、手机，什么都没了。

sentences.en: This woman who stopped and took me to the hospital, she saved my life.
sentences.zh: 那个停下车带我去医院的女人，她救了我的命。

sentences.en: I mean, I've had to buy my own soap.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不得不自己买肥皂。

sentences.en: I've had to buy my own medicine.
sentences.zh: 手术后我不得不自己买药。

sentences.en: I've had to buy my own food after the surgery.
sentences.zh: 我不得不自己买饭吃。

sentences.en: Hospital's not giving me any of that.
sentences.zh: 医院什么都没提供给我。

sentences.en: And without her, I would not be able to do any of these things because I lost all my possessions in this earthquake.
sentences.zh: 如果没有她，我根本无法做到这些，因为我在这次地震中失去了所有的财产。

sentences.en: And then I interviewed the woman and I said, you know, what made you stop?
sentences.zh: 后来我采访了那个救人的女人，我问她，是什么促使你停下车的？

sentences.en: And she said, I've just learned that in this country, we have to rely on ourselves.
sentences.zh: 她说，我早就明白在这个国家，我们只能靠自己。

sentences.en: But there's nothing else.
sentences.zh: 除此之外别无他法。

sentences.en: There's no other support network for us.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何其他的支持网络。

sentences.en: It's just us.
sentences.zh: 只有我们自己。

sentences.en: And how could I not help this woman?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能不帮这个女人呢？

sentences.en: How could I live with myself if I had just decided to pass her on the road and continue on my way?
sentences.zh: 如果我当时选择在路上从她身边开过去、继续赶路，我又怎么能问心无愧地活下去？

sentences.en: Maria, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Tropical Storm Grace pummeled Haiti, soaking victims of the earthquake who are sleeping outside and impeding rescue efforts.
sentences.zh: 周二，热带风暴“格雷斯”袭击海地，淋湿了露天露宿的地震灾民，并阻碍了救援工作。

sentences.en: So far, the death toll from the quake has reached nearly 2,000 people.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，地震已造成近2000人死亡。

sentences.en: And the number of injured has surpassed 9,000.
sentences.zh: 受伤人数已超过9000人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In their first news conference since taking control of Afghanistan,
sentences.zh: 在控制阿富汗之后举行的首次新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: Taliban officials said they planned no reprisals against those who had opposed them and said they would not allow prejudice or violence against women.
sentences.zh: 塔利班官员表示，他们不打算对反对过他们的人进行报复，并表示不允许对女性产生偏见或实施暴力。

sentences.en: But those assurances are being met with skepticism.
sentences.zh: 但这些保证并未消除外界的怀疑。

sentences.en: During their march toward Kabul, the Taliban was accused of carrying out multiple revenge killings.
sentences.zh: 在向喀布尔进军期间，塔利班被指控实施了多起报复性杀害。

sentences.en: And the group brutally repressed women the last time they controlled Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 而且该组织上次控制阿富汗时对女性进行了残酷镇压。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that classified intelligence assessments over the summer warned of the possibility that the Taliban could rapidly take over Afghanistan and that the Afghan military could quickly collapse.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，今年夏天的机密情报评估曾警告称，塔利班可能会迅速接管阿富汗，阿富汗军队可能会迅速崩溃。

sentences.en: Despite those warnings, President Biden publicly played down the prospect that the government might collapse and was caught off guard by the Taliban's final push into Kabul.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些警告，拜登总统公开淡化了政府可能会崩溃的可能性，并对塔利班对喀布尔的最后攻势感到措手不及。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Soraya Shockley, Robert Jimmison, and Daniel Guimet.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由索拉亚·肖克利（Soraya Shockley）、罗伯特·吉米森（Robert Jimmison）和丹尼尔·吉梅特（Daniel Guimet）制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Larissa Anderson, Rachel Quester, and Lisa Chow, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由拉里萨·安德森（Larissa Anderson）、雷切尔·奎斯特（Rachel Quester）和丽莎·周（Lisa Chow）剪辑，克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）负责音频工程。

sentences.en: Original music by Dan Powell and Alisha Baitu.
sentences.zh: 原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）和艾莉莎·拜图（Alisha Baitu）创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为假期的亲友接待做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家一样舒适的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极为敏感、需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App或您常用的播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
